## MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
Neutral regime — normal volatility (Vol: 28.7%) with very narrow participation (Breadth: 0/8 sectors positive), signaling cautious positioning despite contained vol.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Best relative performers are Transportation (BELOW TREND): THYAO (1W: -0.68% | 1M: -2.49%) and TAVHL (1W: +4.00% | 1M: -0.18%) alongside Construction & REIT in CORRECTION: TKFEN (1W: +10.63% | 1M: +16.22%) — leadership is shallow and fragile.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology & Telecom (BELOW TREND): TTKOM (1W: -6.97% | 1M: -2.64%) is worst, followed by Energy & Chemicals (BELOW TREND): SASA (1W: -21.43% | 1M: -0.43%) and Holding & Investment (BELOW TREND): DOHOL (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -8.15%).

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
TKFEN (1W: +10.63% | 1M: +16.22%) ABOVE TREND; TAVHL (1W: +4.00% | 1M: -0.18%) RECOVERY; TOASO (1W: +2.02% | 1M: +3.11%) ABOVE TREND; ASELS (1W: +1.48% | 1M: -6.26%) RECOVERY; BIMAS (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +4.59%) ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
KONTR (1W: -26.44% | 1M: -34.36%) BELOW TREND; SASA (1W: -21.43% | 1M: -0.43%) BELOW TREND; HEKTS (1W: -20.07% | 1M: -20.35%) BELOW TREND; VESTL (1W: -15.08% | 1M: +1.36%) CORRECTION; PETKM (1W: -9.97% | 1M: +3.50%) CORRECTION.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Up: TKFEN (1W: +10.63% | 1M: +16.22%) ABOVE TREND; Down: KONTR (1W: -26.44% | 1M: -34.36%) BELOW TREND and SASA (1W: -21.43% | 1M: -0.43%) BELOW TREND — momentum is one-sided to the downside outside a few construction/retail names.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking is in CORRECTION on mixed internals: HALKB (1W: +0.34% | 1M: +38.13%) ABOVE TREND while AKBNK (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +3.95%) CORRECTION, GARAN (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +2.46%) CORRECTION and ISCTR (1W: -2.02% | 1M: +9.44%) CORRECTION — prefer selective exposure to stronger retail-facing banks.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy industry shows broad weakness: TOASO (1W: +2.02% | 1M: +3.11%) ABOVE TREND and ASELS (1W: +1.48% | 1M: -6.26%) RECOVERY are bright spots, while EREGL (1W: -3.81% | 1M: -1.99%) BELOW TREND and ARCLK (1W: -7.90% | 1M: -6.05%) BELOW TREND signal cyclic strain.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Sector under pressure and ripe for reassessment: TUPRS (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +1.97%) CORRECTION and PETKM (1W: -9.97% | 1M: +3.50%) CORRECTION show divergence; deep sell-offs in SASA (1W: -21.43% | 1M: -0.43%) BELOW TREND and HEKTS (1W: -20.07% | 1M: -20.35%) BELOW TREND increase downside risk.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Neutral stance — keep overall beta moderate, trim high-volatility Energy and Tech positions, add selectively to proven quant leaders and construction/retail winners (TKFEN, BIMAS) and high-conviction bank names (HALKB), while keeping cash for catalyst-driven rotation.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
TKFEN (1W: +10.63% | 1M: +16.22%) ABOVE TREND for momentum follow-through; BIMAS (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +4.59%) ABOVE TREND for defensive earnings resilience; KONTR (1W: -26.44% | 1M: -34.36%) BELOW TREND for technical overshoot or further capitulation; SASA (1W: -21.43% | 1M: -0.43%) BELOW TREND as a volatility play.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Technology & Telecom (BELOW TREND) for follow-through weakness; Energy & Chemicals (BELOW TREND) for spillover from commodity/FX moves; Construction & REIT (CORRECTION/ABOVE TREND pockets) for potential rotation.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch XU100 responsiveness to macro headlines (CBRT commentary, CPI, global rates) and breaks of short-term technical supports (20-day MA breach) as trigger for renewed risk-off; upside requires breadth to recover above mid-term moving averages or better-than-expected corporate flows.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Neutral market with normal volatility but zero sector breadth — gains concentrated in a few names (TKFEN, BIMAS) while Technology and Energy lead the sell-off; recommend selective overweight in high-quant/defensive winners and underweight broad cyclicals until breadth recovers or catalysts arrive.
